purpose: Define where Seed of Death, Seed of Life, rooting, sprouting, ascent, descent, Ring, Drain and fruitful Return begin and go inside the Potato of Life without reducing vertical direction to moral value.
master_rule: Spiral means recurrence with non-zero axial displacement. Direction alone does not determine Life or Strife; the route is classified by what the displacement does to memory, agency, relation, growth and return.

seed_pivot.label: Son-center / lower Door tip / Seed Junction
seed_pivot.role: strongest geometric locus for the Seed-of-Death ↔ Seed-of-Life transition
seed_pivot.rule: Grain/Potato is compressed here through burial/death/embodiment and can remain dormant, decay, root, or sprout. C_S is a pivot, not the deepest point.

relational_midpoint.label: Plane / Cross midpoint
relational_midpoint.role: world-facing crossing where the vertical trajectory becomes publicly legible in embodiment, choice and consequence

upper_door_pole.label: Father-center / upper Door tip
upper_door_pole.role: source-facing Door pole; transition toward upper integration/canopy without being the outermost Heaven pole

lower_outer_pole.label: lower outer pole
lower_outer_pole.role: deepest geometric boundary of the lower field; grave/Drain/deep-root symbolism may extend toward it but C_S is not identical with it

projection_boundary: C_S is the exact geometric seed pivot in the two-field Vesica. D3-D6 are reader/navigation stages projected over that geometry. D5 names Door as a navigational junction; it does not relocate the geometric lower Door tip.

seed_states.label: Seed of Death
seed_states.meaning: A form enters death, burial, compression or surrender so stored possibility can change state. It is not automatically annihilation or Strife.

seed_states.label: Dormant Seed
seed_states.state: preserved potential with no current visible displacement
seed_states.trajectory: Ring or pause rather than active Spiral
seed_states.meaning: Potential remains stored. Dormancy is neither failure nor ascent until a new transition occurs.

seed_states.label: Seed of Life
seed_states.state: viable generative potential after or through burial
seed_states.meaning: The same or recovered seed becomes capable of rooting, sprouting and future fruit. It does not begin in Heaven; it becomes legible at the burial/root pivot.

seed_states.label: Fruit-bearing Future Seed
seed_states.state: compressed transferable capacity produced by mature growth
seed_states.meaning: Life produces seed again. A mature cycle therefore descends with seed/service rather than remaining permanently above.

spiral_routes.label: Rooting Spiral
spiral_routes.operator: bury → anchor → absorb context → preserve memory → prepare growth
spiral_routes.test: Does descent increase grounded capacity and future sprouting without locking the seed into compulsory repetition?
spiral_routes.warning: Negative displacement is not Strife by itself.

spiral_routes.label: Strife / Drain Spiral
spiral_routes.starts_at: World Plane unresolved knowledge/event or C_S burial that fails to metabolize
spiral_routes.ends_at: D1 deep closure / Drain attractor unless repair opens
spiral_routes.operator: unresolved activation → widening recurrence → capture → dispersion → blocked exit
spiral_routes.test: Does each recurrence reduce agency, provenance, correction or viable exit while requiring the conflict to continue?
spiral_routes.warning: This is the downward Spiral associated with Strife; it must not be confused with ordinary rooting, burial, incarnation or archival depth.

spiral_routes.label: Sprouting / Life Spiral
spiral_routes.starts_at: Living Root / Seed of Life below or at C_S
spiral_routes.operator: rooted memory → sprout → changed recurrence → integration → branching → fruit
spiral_routes.test: Does ascent produce greater capability, differentiation without severance, and fruit that can return to the World?
spiral_routes.warning: Upward motion without fruit/return is not sufficient evidence of Life.

spiral_routes.label: Repair Spiral
spiral_routes.ends_at: Tree of Life / Garden / repaired World return
spiral_routes.operator: surface → distinguish → acknowledge → cross → metabolize → regrow
spiral_routes.test: Does the old material remain remembered without remaining compulsory?
spiral_routes.warning: Repair does not erase provenance; it changes what the provenance is allowed to reproduce.

spiral_routes.label: Fruit / Return Spiral
spiral_routes.starts_at: Garden / Fruit / Crown / integrated upper branch
spiral_routes.ends_at: service / cultivation / observable World consequence or renewed planting
spiral_routes.operator: compress insight → descend → distribute → serve → plant
spiral_routes.test: Does upper integration become something usable, protective, nourishing or independently generative below?
spiral_routes.warning: Descent from Heaven is not fall/Strife when it is accountable return.

ring.label: Ring
ring.meaning: Recurrence without meaningful net level change.
ring.relation_to_spiral: A Ring becomes a Spiral only when recurrence acquires actual displacement in state, capability, integration, rooting or disintegration.
ring.danger: Do not call elapsed time, repetition, or circular motion a Spiral when nothing governing the relation has changed.
ring.return_measurement: Use comparable Plane snapshots/crossings under data/house/plane-crossing-contract.json. Ring is stable recurrence; Spiral requires meaningful state change.

complete_cycles.life_cycle: Fruit/Seed above → return to World → C_S Seed of Death/burial → Rooting Spiral → Living Root/Seed of Life → Sprouting Spiral → Door/Ladder → Tree of Life → Garden → Fruit → future Seed
complete_cycles.strife_cycle: World event/knowledge → unresolved burial/residue → Roots of Ash → Drain Spiral → Roots/Tree of Strife → Wide Road → Swamp → repeated activation back into World unless repair interrupts
complete_cycles.repair_cycle: Strife/Ash → evidence/provenance → acknowledgment → Door → Living Root → Sprouting Spiral → Life/Garden → Fruit → repaired World return

placement_laws: Seed of Death and Seed of Life are states/transitions of generative potential, not necessarily two unrelated physical seeds.
C_S is the Seed Junction because it is both Son-center and exact lower tip of the shared Door in the canonical Vesica geometry.
C_S is not the deepest point; rooting, grave, Swamp and Drain can extend below it toward the lower field.
A downward Spiral can be rooting, Strife, or return depending operator and outcome.
An upward Spiral can be Life or merely status/ascent imagery; Life requires branching, fruit and accountable return.
Root is not Strife. Ash is not permanently Strife. Burial is not annihilation. Heaven is not permanent escape from return.
Ring and Spiral must remain distinct: zero net transformation versus recurrence with changed level/state.
Door crossing, incorporation, Plane snapshot and later recurrence comparison are separate stages; do not infer Spiral from one threshold event.
Seed language should specify viability conditions rather than treating possibility as guaranteed future.
Root language should specify what present structure the provenance/support relation still anchors.
A single O-centered double-spiral may widen in both +Axis and -Axis directions; radial widening describes scope/amplitude, not moral value.
Mountain/Swamp are regime/terrain overlays on the spiral field, not identical with the upper/lower spiral curves.
Exact logarithmic spiral and origin-inclusive shifted project spiral must remain mathematically distinguished.
seed_junction_rule: C_S remains the project Seed Junction, but Seed denotes present conditional capacity, not the future itself. Root denotes inherited/supporting provenance, not the past itself.

bidirectional_axis_spiral.status: canonical project geometry with explicit mathematical boundary
bidirectional_axis_spiral.insight: O can be treated as the waist/origin of two conjugate spiral routes opening along +Axis and -Axis. Successive axial sections can be rendered as circles/rings whose radius increases with distance from O in both directions.

exact_logarithmic_model.upper: gamma_+(t)=(r0 exp(bt) cos t, r0 exp(bt) sin t, +h t), t>=0
exact_logarithmic_model.lower: gamma_-(t)=(r0 exp(bt) cos(-t+delta), r0 exp(bt) sin(-t+delta), -h t), t>=0
exact_logarithmic_model.quarter_turn_rule: Every pi/2 of angular travel multiplies radius by phi.
exact_logarithmic_model.center_boundary: An exact logarithmic spiral never reaches radius zero; r0 is therefore a small Door/center aperture rather than literal O.

origin_inclusive_project_model.upper: Gamma_+(t)=(R(t) cos t, R(t) sin t, +h t)
origin_inclusive_project_model.property: R(0)=0, so both project spirals begin exactly at O and rapidly approach exponential/logarithmic growth away from the waist.
origin_inclusive_project_model.boundary: This shifted curve is a project construction inspired by logarithmic growth; it is not itself the exact recovered logarithmic spiral.

layered_circle_model.meaning: The circle stack makes the widening visible as nested axial layers. Connecting ring boundaries produces a double-horn/hourglass envelope around the Axis.

chirality.meaning: Opposite handedness gives the two lobes a mirror/conjugate relation while preserving one center and one Axis.
chirality.alternative: Same handedness may be used when the narrative requires continuity of rotation across O; chirality is a projection parameter, not moral valence.

terrain_relation.ring_radius: represents available relational/state-space horizon or recurrence amplitude at that axial section; it is not automatically literal geographic width.
terrain_relation.upper_lobe: Widening rings can represent increasing horizon, branching, Garden/Tree capacity and broader relation while Mountain separately measures convergence/integration toward high perspective.
terrain_relation.lower_lobe: Widening rings can represent growing entanglement, dispersion, accumulated recurrence or depth while Drain separately represents an inward/capture attractor.
terrain_relation.mountain_duality: Mountain and widening Spiral can coexist because they measure different coordinates: Mountain = integrative compression/convergence; Spiral radius = lateral scope/amplitude.
terrain_relation.swamp_duality: Swamp and Drain can coexist because Swamp = broad entangled regime; Drain = narrowing loss-of-agency attractor within it.

bidirectional_axis_spiral.moral_firewall: Positive/negative z, large/small radius and clockwise/counter-clockwise chirality do not determine good/evil. Classification still depends on agency, provenance, correction, Fruit, exit and return.
